summary_en: This study tests vemurafenib given together with metformin in people with unresectable stage IIIC or stage IV melanoma that has the BRAF V600E change. Vemurafenib is taken by mouth at 960 mg once daily, and metformin is taken by mouth at 500 mg twice daily for 2 weeks, then 850 mg twice daily; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The main outcome is safety, and the phase II part also looks at clinical activity; the study is phase 1/2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa vemurafenib combinado con metformina en personas con melanoma en estadio IIIC o IV no resecable que tiene el cambio BRAF V600E. El vemurafenib se toma por vía oral a 960 mg una vez al día, y la metformina se toma por vía oral a 500 mg dos veces al día durante 2 semanas, luego 850 mg dos veces al día; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El resultado principal es la seguridad, y la parte de fase II también evalúa la actividad clínica; el estudio es de fase 1/2.
who_for: Age 18 or older with histologically confirmed BRAF V600E melanoma, stage IIIC or IV.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
At least one site of measurable disease by RECIST 1.1.
Adequate blood, kidney and liver test results within 42 days before dosing.
Agrees to required contraception and gives written informed consent.
not_for: Known allergy to metformin or any of its components.
Melanoma that progressed while on metformin.
Radiotherapy for non-CNS disease within 2 weeks before study treatment, or unrecovered radiation side effects above grade 1 (except hair loss).
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or not using required birth control; or uncontrolled infection or condition that could interfere.
